notes: Competing reading for t001/t003: reading *Be thou* as the finite verb's frame and giving only *diligent* to the infinitive absolute; taken as above because rule 56 gives the infinitive absolute whatever the ASV spends on its emphasis and rule 17 leaves the finite verb its own subject, which the ASV writes as the *thou* of *Be thou*.
The supplied *thy* of *thy herds* is placed on the suffix of לִבְּךָ rather than marked added, since a possessive morpheme stands in the clause for it (rule 41's closing sentences).

Review of the flagged שִׁית + לֵב grouping: neither *look* nor *well* writes either morpheme's own lexeme, so no non-arbitrary allocation exists and rule 6's first-token fallback stands; the alternative of giving *look* to שִׁית and marking לֵב unrepresented is what rules 22 and 30 forbid for a morpheme whose sense the English rendering carries.
